description: This file defines the EmailSubscriptionController class within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component named 'email-subscription-list' in its preRender method. It is responsible for managing email subscription views in the HRM system's admin interface.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling email subscription UI in the admin plugin, extending AbstractVueController and initializing the Vue component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view by setting the email subscription list component for rendering.
